heavy_strikes.name: Heavy Strikes
heavy_strikes.description: Unleash a series of punishing, bone-crushing blows. Make {attack_count} empowered strikes, each dealing {dice} physical damage.

action_surge.name: Action Surge
action_surge.description: Push your body beyond its natural limits for an explosive burst of speed. Make {attack_count} devastating strikes, each dealing a massive {dice} physical damage.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Dig deep and call upon your hidden reserves of stamina to push through the pain. Instantly restores {dice} HP.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Bellow a mighty challenge that demands the attention of the entire battlefield. ALL enemies must save or become {effect} for {duration} turns. Taunted enemies suffer a {bonus_spell_save} penalty to their spell saves.

precision_strike.name: Precision Strike
precision_strike.description: Identify a critical weakness in your enemy's guard and deliver a flawless, unavoidable strike. Unfailingly deals {dice} precision damage.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.description: Shrug off grievous, life-threatening wounds through sheer, unwavering willpower. Instantly restores {dice} HP, and continues to heal you for {hot_dice} HP at the start of each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Step inside your opponent's guard and deliver a crushing, concussive blow with your shield. Deals {dice} bludgeoning damage. On a hit, leaves the target {effect} for {duration} turns.

death_blow.name: Death Blow
death_blow.description: Execute a lethal, calculated strike to a major artery. Unavoidably deals a massive {dice} physical damage and inflicts severe bleeding, causing the target to suffer an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn.

flurry_of_blows.name: Flurry of Blows
flurry_of_blows.description: Channel your ki to unleash a blindingly fast barrage of strikes. Modifies your standard attack count by {attack_count_overide}, with each rapid blow dealing {dice} physical damage.

flowing_strikes.name: Flowing Strikes
flowing_strikes.description: Weave through the battlefield in a deadly, evasive dance, striking out at everyone around you. Deals {dice} damage to all enemies in the area. A successful save halves the damage.

stunning_strike.name: Stunning Strike
stunning_strike.description: Deliver a precise, paralyzing blow that violently disrupts the flow of ki in your opponent's body. Deals {dice} physical damage and leaves the target {effect} for {duration} turns.

wholeness_of_body.name: Wholeness of Body
wholeness_of_body.description: Channel your inner energy to rapidly mend your wounds through intense combat meditation. Instantly restores {dice} HP, and continues to heal you for {hot_dice} HP at the start of each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

chakra_blocking.name: Chakra Blocking
chakra_blocking.description: Unleash a relentless flurry of targeted strikes to seal the enemy's chakras. Modifies your standard attack count by {attack_count_overide}, with each strike dealing {dice} physical damage. Hits inflict a {power} penalty to the target's rolls ({effect}).

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: Enter a state of heightened reflexes, becoming impossibly agile and elusive. For {duration} turns, gain +{bonus_ac} to your Armor Class, +{bonus_magic_resistance} to your Magic Resistance, and all incoming spell damage is reduced by half.

ki_wave.name: Ki Wave
ki_wave.description: Violently expel your spiritual energy, unleashing a massive shockwave in all directions. Deals {dice} force damage to ALL enemies on the battlefield. A successful save halves the damage.

quivering_palm.name: Quivering Palm
quivering_palm.description: Strike an opponent with palm techniques that send lethal, imperceptible vibrations through their body. Unavoidably deals an initial {dice} physical damage, and continues to tear them apart from the inside for {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack.description: Exploit a momentary opening for a calculated, devastating blow. Make {attack_count} precise strikes, each dealing {dice} physical damage.

poison_strike.name: Poison Strike
poison_strike.description: Lash out with a toxic blade. Deals an initial {dice} physical damage and envenoms the target, inflicting a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}) and dealing {dot_dice} poison damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.description: Strike from the shadows with lethal, merciless precision before the enemy can react. Deals a catastrophic {dice} physical damage.

vital_strike.name: Vital Strike
vital_strike.description: Sever a major artery with a surgical, crippling blow. Deals {dice} physical damage and inflicts severe bleeding, causing the target to suffer an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Detonate a volatile powder charge to blind and disorient the entire battlefield. Deals {dice} damage to ALL enemies. A failed save leaves them choking and obscured, inflicting a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}).

emergency_rations.name: Emergency Rations
emergency_rations.description: Quickly consume a magically infused ration to patch yourself up mid-combat. Instantly restores {dice} HP.

throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
throwing_knives.description: Unleash a fan of razor-sharp blades in a deadly arc. Deals an initial {dice} piercing damage to all enemies in the area. Those who fail their save suffer deep lacerations, bleeding for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

death_strike.name: Death Strike
death_strike.description: Execute a flawless, unavoidable killing blow targeting an enemy's most vital organs. Unfailingly deals a massive {dice} physical damage.

steady_shot.name: Steady Shot
steady_shot.description: Take a steady breath and loose a precisely aimed arrow that flawlessly finds its mark. Unavoidably deals {dice} physical damage.

volley.name: Volley
volley.description: Fire a rapid barrage of arrows high into the air, raining death upon a clustered area. Deals {dice} physical damage to all enemies in the blast zone. A successful save halves the damage.

first_aid.name: First Aid
first_aid.description: Rely on your wilderness survival instincts to quickly patch up severe wounds. Instantly restores {dice} HP to yourself or an ally.

summon_wolf.name: Summon Wolf
summon_wolf.description: Call upon the primal spirits of the wild to aid your hunt. Summons {summon_count} spectral Wolf (or Wolves) to fight by your side.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.description: Draw your bowstring to its absolute limit, firing a devastating, armor-piercing arrow. Unfailingly deals an initial {dice} physical damage and inflicts deep, bleeding wounds that cause an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

entangling_shot.name: Entangling Shot
entangling_shot.description: Fire an arrow that bursts into grasping, magical vines upon impact. Deals {dice} damage and ensnares the target, inflicting a {power} penalty to their rolls ({effect}).

rapid_fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire.description: Unleash a blistering volley of arrows in the blink of an eye. Make {attack_count_overide} ranged attacks, each dealing {dice} damage.

explosive_arrow.name: Explosive Arrow
explosive_arrow.description: Fire a heavily modified arrow tipped with a highly volatile charge. Erupts on impact, dealing {dice} fire and piercing damage to ALL enemies on the battlefield.

sniper_shot.name: Sniper Shot
sniper_shot.description: Take careful aim and deliver a single, perfectly placed shot to a vital organ. Unavoidably deals a catastrophic {dice} precision damage.

summon_owlbear.name: Summon Owlbear
summon_owlbear.description: Call upon the primal power of nature to summon an Owlbear.
